name: attendance-web

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix server" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.deploy:staging:api: npm run prepare:lambda && sam build && sam deploy --config-file samconfig.staging.toml --no-confirm-changeset
scripts.deploy:staging:frontend: npm run build --prefix client && aws s3 sync client/dist s3://grubpac-attendance-web-staging-662252246711 --delete && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E2RJX8BNEIE0D --paths "/*"

description: Internal employee attendance system for **Grubpac Technologies** — React (Vite) client + Node/Express API + MongoDB.
